newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MILAN'S DAVIDS RELEASED FROM HOSPITAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MILAN'S DAVIDS RELEASED FROM HOSPITAL.

text.p: AC Milan's Dutch midfielder Edgar Davids was released from hospital on Friday following surgery on his fractured right leg.

Davids, who broke his leg in two places last Sunday when he collided with goalkeeper Luca Bucci in a 1-0 defeat at lowly Perugia, underwent a successful operation on Monday in the central town of Terni.
The surgeon, Giuliano Cerulli, told reporters that Davids was expected to return to the pitch within six months.
His injury was the latest blow to defending champions Milan, who are having a nightmare season, well out of the league title hunt and eliminated from the European Cup.
